name: Anwen Pell
source_profile:
Anwen Pell (NG) — Independent Stockyard Proprietor

Anwen is a respected horsewoman and former cattle drover who operates one of Redvale's few remaining independent livestock pens adjoining the Redwash Exchange. Her business caters primarily to independent ranchers and traveling herders who cannot afford the Four-Spur Company's fees or prefer not to accept its purchasing contracts.

Anwen maintains commercial friendships with several Varkesh and Rathen families, whose livestock and horses frequently pass through her yards. She is increasingly concerned that Four-Spur's growing control over the local livestock trade will eventually force smaller competitors out of business.

Anwen has become an informal representative of the town's independent ranchers and merchants, many of whom resent Four-Spur's growing control over livestock prices and access to grazing lands. She is particularly critical of Hugh Maddox, whose armed company riders have repeatedly intimidated smaller ranchers involved in disputed land claims.

Her relationship with Della Mercer, Four-Spur's experienced trail boss, is more complicated. The two women respect one another as accomplished horsewomen and former drovers, and Anwen believes Della is considerably more honorable than some of her employers. Nevertheless, their professional loyalties increasingly place them on opposing sides of the town's commercial disputes.
